name: Place a hold on a member's share
description:
Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator (a supervisor -- this is a supervisor-gated, restricted action requiring override). Look up the member by member number and open their record. The 'share' input below is only a placeholder -- the exact share IDs for this member are not known in advance, so ignore its literal text for selection. Instead, read the member's shares list, confirm this member has no share already on HOLD (choose a different member if they do), and select the FIRST share whose status is OPEN, using its exact share ID as shown in the hold-target dropdown option -- not a guessed product name. Start placing a hold on that share. The 'reason_code' and 'notes' inputs describe the intent but are not guaranteed to match exact on-screen text: from the actual reason-code dropdown, pick whichever real option most closely matches 'routine review' (or the closest available reason code shown), and enter the given notes text into the free-text notes field if one is present. Go through the review step, provide the supervisor override where prompted, read the hidden per-transaction security token off the page, then post it. This action is risky and irreversible once posted. Read back the confirmation reference after posting.

Returns: confirmation_ref — Confirmation reference shown after posting.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found, permission_denied.
